name: tribunal-kit
description: Multi-agent coding governance, 28-specialist review waves, and Subagent-Driven Development (SDD) engine.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code tool mapping for Tribunal-Kit:

- When Tribunal rules or skills require user clarification or Socratic gates, call Kimi Code's `AskUserQuestion` tool with concrete options. Put the recommended option first.
- When a skill refers to `TodoWrite`, use Kimi Code's `TodoList` tool.
- When running Subagent-Driven Development (`/sdd`) or reviewing tasks, use Kimi Code's `Agent` tool with `subagent_type: "coder"` for implementation and reviewer subagents. Use `subagent_type: "explore"` for read-only codebase exploration.
- Keep implementers isolated: implementers read `.tribunal/sdd/<plan>/task-<N>-brief.md` and write `task-<N>-report.md`, returning <15 lines status.
- Reviewers inspect `.tribunal/sdd/<plan>/review-<base>..<head>.diff` out-of-band and emit structured verdicts.
- Enforce the Iron Law of TDD and Verification-Before-Completion on every change.

interface.longDescription: Tribunal Kit provides institutional-grade code review, anti-hallucination guardrails, Subagent-Driven Development (SDD), and automated testing pipelines for AI coding agents.
